title: Complementability of separable spaces $\mathcal{C}(K)$ in Banach spaces
summary: For a metric compact space $L$ and a Banach space $E$, we provide a characterization of the complementability of the Banach space $\mathcal{C}(L)$ of continuous functions on $L$ inside $E$ in terms of the existence of a certain tree in the product $E \times E^*$, based on new descriptions of the Banach spaces $\mathcal{C}([1, ω^α])$ for countable ordinal numbers $α$ and $\mathcal{C}(2^ω)$.
